M with hydrocele associated with Anemia"},"content":{"type":"html","$t":"\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp;This is an online e log book to discuss our patient de-identified health data shared after taking his \/ her \/ guardians signed informed consent. Here we discuss our individual patients problems through series of inputs from available global online community of experts with an aim to solve those patients clinical problem with collective current best evident based input.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThis E blog also reflects my patient centered online learning portfolio and your valuable inputs on the comment box is welcome.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EI have been given this case to solve in an attempt to understand the topic of \" patient clinical data analysis\" to develop my competency in reading and comprehending clinical data including history, clinical findings, investigations and come up with diagnosis and treatment\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EA 60 year old male resident of suryapet district came to opd with chief complaints of swelling in scrotum since 15 years and blood in urine since 2 months\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EHistory of presenting illness:\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPatient was apparently asymptomatic 15 years back then he developed swelling in the scrotum after trauma(while lifting the lorry back door, he slipped and got injured during this) the swelling was sudden in onset gradually progressive painless( the reason why he ignored the swelling) not associated with any relieving and aggravating factor\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPatient was apparently asymptomatic 2 months back. Then he noticed blood in urine, which\u0026nbsp; was insidious in onset gradually progressive also he has increased frequeny of urine which was increased during night almost every 20-25 minutes. The urine was red in colourtg the following thing was observed by the patient During urination patient first passes red colour urine and then the urine stops for a few seconds then later he passes black coloured clots with burning sensation.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENo H\/O fever, cough and cold.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENo H\/o orthopnea and paroxysmal nocturnal dyspnea.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENo H\/O nausea, vomiting, loose stools and constipation.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENo H\/O abdominal distension, abdominal pain.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPAST HISTORY:\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003Ehistory of hydrocele 15 years back as mentioned above\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EIn 2019 his wife got a swelling in the post auricular region for which be came to our hospital\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EThen he also went for checkup for the swelling in scrotum where our doctors diagnosed it as hydrocele. And suggested to have surgery to be done for it. But he refused to it because he has no money for surgery at that time and his wife just got treated.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EDuring corona time, he again visited our hospital with sufficient money( given by his son). But it was very difficult to do surgery at that time because of high wave period of corona patients in the hospital. Then he went back to his village.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EHe has 3 daughters and one son, all are married and lives at different places except his son who lives in the same village.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EDue to issues between him and his son in law family A case was filed against him and then due to this the management removed him from his job.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EFrom then he was staying at home with no specific job, but went to some contracted works in farming fields.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENo H\/O HTN, diabetes, asthma, epilepsy, TB.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENo H\/O any past surgery.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EH\/O fracture of left humerus at distal end, when he was 20 years old, while cutting a tree. Then he got treated for it with reduction and plaster of Paris. But the treatment Resulted in malunuion\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPERSONAL HISTORY:\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAppetite: normal\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ESleep: inadequate\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EBowel and bladder: regular\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAddictions: alcohol intake 90ml per day since 38 years stopped since 2 months.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E\u0026nbsp;Smoking daily 10 beedi(2 days 1 packet) from 38 years, stopped from 2 months.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EDaily schedule :\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EWake up at 6 am\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EBreakfast(idli\/ dosa)\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003Ework if any or rest\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E12PM lunch (Rice+ curry( veg\/ non veg)+ dal )\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EAfternoon rest\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EEvening walking and talking with his neighbours\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E8 pm ( dinner)\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003E10 pm dinner\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EFAMILY HISTORY:\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003ENo significant history.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EGENERAL EXAMINATION:\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPatient is conscious, coherent, and co-operative. Well oriented to time place and person.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EHe is moderately built and moderately nourished.\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EPallor- present\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EIcterus: exposure with patient. So when my clinical posting started i was excited, curious, enthusiastic and nervous all at the same time. First few days were so confusing and hard to understand but with time things got easier by observing seniors taking cases and interacting and clearing doubts with PGs and professors.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/p\u003E\u003Cp\u003EI understood the importance of history taking and how it plays an important role in the diagnoses of the patient's conditions. The most amazing part\u0026nbsp; was to come up with differential diagnosis based on the\u0026nbsp; signs and symptoms of patients which made me realise how expansive general medicine.
